verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a REST API reference with endpoint tables (e.g., connector deletion-lock and quarantine-release endpoints), but nothing shows an interactive explorer, try-it console, or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. A static endpoint listing is adjacent to the story and does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
